title: release-notes template variables
description: Values for templates/release-notes.md.j2 and templates/release-notes.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from release-notes.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

date.title: Date
date.description: Date this actually reached users, ISO. Not the merge date and not the planned date; support correlates incidents against the day behaviour changed for real people.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.description: One or two plain sentences leading with what changed for the user. The lint rejects excited, seamless, powerful and revolutionary - write what a user would tell a colleague in a corridor.

support_link.title: Support link
support_link.description: Where a reader goes when this release broke something for them. A release note with no exit is a wall people shout at on social media instead of a channel you can answer.

version.title: Version
version.description: The released version, semver. Read it off the tag, not off the plan - this string is the anchor for every support conversation about this change for the next year.
